paragraphs.text: Day 6 · A full-day yacht excursion to Bartolomé (about 2 hours each way), watching for dolphins on the way. A 30-minute climb over a lunar landscape leads to the summit, with views of Santiago, Rábida, Chinese Hat and the iconic Pinnacle Rock, one of the most photographed scenes in the Galápagos. Then beach time and snorkelling in clear, shallow water, often with Galápagos penguins, reef sharks, rays, sea turtles and tropical fish, as well as marine iguanas, sea lions and pelicans. Lunch on board. Overnight at Hotel Fiesta 4★. (B, L)

blocks.text: 17 August 2027. North Seymour or South Plaza

paragraphs.text: Day 7 · A full-day yacht excursion to North Seymour or South Plaza (confirmed after booking). North Seymour: palo santo forest, frigatebirds inflating their red throat pouches and blue-footed boobies dancing, then the beach and lagoon of Las Bachas, often with flamingos, for swimming and snorkelling. South Plaza: a carpet of red and green sesuvium, sea lions, land iguanas and cliffs where swallow-tailed gulls and tropicbirds nest, followed by snorkelling at Punta Carrión. Lunch on board. Overnight at Hotel Fiesta 4★. (B, L)
